description: Lets the agent define brand-new callable tools at runtime (a self-contained Python function stored in the database). No credentials, no filesystem/network access.
skill_summary: How to mint a new tool with create_tool — the five required pieces (name = function name, JSON-Schema parameters, async code, and the required stages list e.g. ['execute_tools']), the upsert-by-name behaviour, the safety scanner, and verifying the tool by calling it. Load before defining any custom tool.
